service_boundary: Represents the mainland platform operated at siliconflow.cn by a Chinese entity, not the separately operated international platform whose terms exclude mainland users, and not the model publishers whose weights it serves.
regional_controls: Geography is chosen by platform rather than by parameter: this platform serves mainland users while the international site excludes them. No region parameter is documented; stricter isolation is offered commercially through customer-cloud, private, and on-premises deployment.
retention_controls: The platform terms state that the operator will not access interaction data, will not use or disclose it without authorisation, and will not store any of it, separating that from telemetry which may be used to improve products. No clause authorises training on customer interaction data.
routing: Customers select a model identifier per request. Rate limits are published per model across several metrics with tier-based upgrade paths, and batch jobs are exempt from online limits. Reserved instances provide guaranteed throughput.
customization: Fine-tuning of an enumerated model set from chat-format datasets with one-click deployment of the result, plus custom-model onboarding and hybrid or private deployment.
strengths: Terms state the operator will not access, use, disclose, or store interaction data, which is stronger than the usual no-training assurance.
One base path serves two major compatible conventions alongside native reranking, audio, and video endpoints.
Serving spans serverless, reserved capacity with an enterprise commitment, dedicated and elastic instances, and private deployment.
tradeoffs: Operated by a separate entity from the international platform, with separate hosts, keys, and consoles, so neither is a superset of the other.
No first-party models and no region parameter, so model availability and processing geography both follow the platform you sign up to.
Batch jobs are capped in size and line count, with result links expiring after a month.
